name: Thornwood Edge
opening: The road ends at a signpost with both arrows scratched out. Between the dark pines, a ring of tiny glowing lights drifts towards you, and behind them a great grey wolf limps into view, one paw held off the ground. It growls, but it doesn't run.
picture: medium shot, (a great grey wolf with a hurt paw limping out of dark pine trees towards the hero, tiny glowing wisps floating around it:1.25), (scratched-out wooden signpost at a forest edge:1.1), misty twilight
background: the edge of a dark pine forest, a crossroads signpost with scratched-out arrows, a mossy path
beats: Find a safe path into the forest
Discover what the lights between the trees are
Help the wounded wolf that guards the old grove
style: misty teal, fireflies, deep pine shadows
secret: The lights are lost spirits, and the wolf is protecting them from a hungry witch.

cast.the grey wolf: a great grey wolf with a silver-streaked muzzle and a hurt front paw
cast.the wisps: tiny floating balls of soft blue-white light
